title: Sparkly helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rotor blades -->
  <g>
    <rect x='12' y='18' width='76' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
    <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='18' rx='4' fill='#81D4FA'/>
    <!-- Rotor hub -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='6' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='3' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x='62' y='38' width='30' height='10' rx='5' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <rect x='86' y='28' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='43' r='4' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- Main body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#FFA270'/>

  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='46' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#B3E5FC'/>

  <!-- Skids -->
  <rect x='20' y='72' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <rect x='28' y='64' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#90A4AE'/>
  <rect x='50' y='64' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#90A4AE'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFEB3B'>
    <!-- sparkle top left -->
    <path d='M14 10 L16 15 L21 16 L16 17 L14 22 L12 17 L7 16 L12 15Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle top right -->
    <path d='M78 8 L79.5 12 L83.5 13 L79.5 14 L78 18 L76.5 14 L72.5 13 L76.5 12Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle left -->
    <path d='M6 42 L7.5 46 L11.5 47 L7.5 48 L6 52 L4.5 48 L0.5 47 L4.5 46Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom right -->
    <path d='M80 66 L81.5 70 L85.5 71 L81.5 72 L80 76 L78.5 72 L74.5 71 L78.5 70Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkle -->
    <path d='M68 22 L69 24.5 L71.5 25.5 L69 26.5 L68 29 L67 26.5 L64.5 25.5 L67 24.5Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra tiny sparkles in white -->
  <g fill='#E1F5FE'>
    <path d='M22 8 L22.8 10 L24.8 10.8 L22.8 11.6 L22 13.6 L21.2 11.6 L19.2 10.8 L21.2 10Z'/>
    <path d='M90 52 L90.7 54 L92.7 54.7 L90.7 55.4 L90 57.4 L89.3 55.4 L87.3 54.7 L89.3 54Z'/>
    <path d='M72 82 L72.7 84 L74.7 84.7 L72.7 85.4 L72 87.4 L71.3 85.4 L69.3 84.7 L71.3 84Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
